content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim remains denied CO-50 after correction and a medical-necessity appeal, and the payer considers the CPT/diagnosis pairing invalid. A human specialist must review the clinical record and prior appeal for a documented, compliant coding or appeal path."}
